## Flagship Shipped Products

- [Tempo (Progressive Interval Visualizer)](https://alim.dest.page/projects/tempo): Zero-dependency running interval HUD decomposing durations into symmetric Push-Pull stages with 60 FPS procedural SVG inverse kinematics.
- [Ocus (EU Compliance Operations OS)](https://alim.dest.page/projects/ocus): Institutional platform translating EU MiCA, DORA, and DAC8 directives into an executable 31-node compliance DAG and 15-week Gantt cockpit.
- [Residual Intellect (AI News Radar)](https://alim.dest.page/projects/residual-intellect): Automated AI tech digest pipeline and sci-fi prophecy tracker comparing 16+ classic tech predictions against real launches.
- [Plain (The Simple Planner)](https://alim.dest.page/projects/goal-classifier): Minimalist four-dimension goal workspace with client-side Web Crypto API (AES-GCM) encrypted BYOK strategic decomposition.
- [Nebuly (Executive AI Brief Platform)](https://alim.dest.page/projects/nebuly): Enterprise AI analytics platform linking executive decision briefs with OHLC conversation telemetry and multi-order ROI simulation.
